data.title: China Shengmu Replaces Materials Supply Framework Agreement
data.description:
China Shengmu Organic Milk Ltd ( (HK:1432) ) has provided an announcement.

China Shengmu Organic Milk Limited said its indirect wholly owned subsidiary, Shengmu High-tech, entered into a 2026-2027 Modern Farming Materials Supply Framework Agreement with Modern Farming on 13 November 2026. The agreement terminates and replaces the existing framework and revises the annual caps, citing anticipated changes in material needs, including increased flaked corn use, and efforts to improve procurement cost efficiency after the Company became a China Modern Dairy subsidiary.

The Company is regarded as having a Significant Public Float Shortfall after failing to maintain the minimum public float required under the Listing Rules. Shareholders and potential investors were advised to exercise caution when dealing in the shares.

China Modern Dairy directly holds approximately 53.53% of the Company’s issued shares and Modern Farming is 98.36%-owned by China Modern Dairy, making both entities connected persons. Because the applicable percentage ratios for the highest revised annual cap exceed 0.1% but are below 5%, the transaction is subject to reporting and announcement requirements but exempt from independent shareholders’ approval.

data.title: Poly Property Services Proposes Pan Zhihua Appointment; Liu Ping Tenders Resignation
data.description:
Poly Property Services Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:6049) ) has shared an announcement.

Poly Property Services Co., Ltd. said its controlling shareholder, Poly Developments and Holdings Co., Ltd., nominated Pan Zhihua as a candidate for non-executive director, and the board approved him as a candidate. His appointment requires shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting, and he would receive no director’s fee during his term.

Pan is currently a director and general manager of Poly Developments and Holdings. Separately, Liu Ping tendered his resignation as a non-executive director and from the nomination and strategy and sustainability committees due to work adjustment, effective November 13, 2026.

data.title: Beijing Capital International Airport Proposes Candidates for 10th Board
data.description:
An update from Beijing Capital International Airport Co ( (HK:0694) ) is now available.

Beijing Capital International Airport Co said its Board approved proposed candidates for the 10th session of the Board. The nominees are Song Kun and Li Yongbing as executive directors; Du Qiang and Xue Rongguo as non-executive directors; and Zhang Jiali, Stanley Hui Hon-chung, Wang Huacheng and Duan Donghui as independent non-executive directors.

Shareholders will consider the proposed appointments at an extraordinary general meeting on 17 December 2026, while the ninth Board will continue performing its duties until then. Employee director Liu Jiliang, who was re-elected for the 10th session, will not be subject to the meeting’s election.

The Nomination Committee said the proposed candidates meet the required character, integrity, experience and independence standards, and that the proposed Board composition complies with applicable rules and the company’s diversity policy. Zhang Jiali has served as an independent non-executive director since June 2017 and, because his service exceeds nine years, his further appointment will require a separate shareholder resolution.

data.title: China Feihe Adds Infant Formula Raw Materials to Procurement Agreement
data.description:
An announcement from China Feihe Limited ( (HK:6186) ) is now available.

China Feihe Limited is involved in infant milk formula supply-chain activities, including agricultural products and infant milk formula raw materials, and related warehousing, storage and logistics services through subsidiaries.

On November 13, 2026, Feihe HLJ and North Latitude 47 amended and extended procurement arrangements to add infant milk formula raw materials, with the renewed agreement running through December 31, 2028. Feihe HLJ also agreed to sell certain raw materials to North Latitude 47 and provide warehousing, storage and logistics services over the same period.

North Latitude 47 is an associate of Feihe’s controlling shareholder and therefore a connected person under the Listing Rules, making the three agreements continuing connected transactions. The product expansion led to revisions of procurement annual caps for 2026 and 2027 and a new cap for 2028, while other procurement terms remain unchanged.

data.title: Tian Chang Subsidiary Orders Seven Plastic Injection Molding Machines
data.description:
Tian Chang Group Holdings Ltd. ( (HK:2182) ) has provided an announcement.

Tian Chang Group Holdings Ltd. is incorporated in the Cayman Islands; the release does not state its industry, primary products or services, or market focus. Its indirect wholly owned subsidiary, Huizhou Tian Chang, placed an order for seven plastic injection molding machines from Vendor B for RMB6.9 million (approximately HK$8.1 million) on 13 November 2026.

Under a related finance lease, Ningbo Zhongjin will purchase the machinery from Huizhou Tian Chang for RMB6.2 million (approximately HK$7.3 million) and lease it back for 41 months, including five rent-free months. Huizhou Tian Chang will fund a RMB0.7 million deposit internally, while 90% of the purchase consideration will be financed through the lease, making the transaction a discloseable transaction.

data.title: Changhong Jiahua Announces Agreement Renewals With Connected Parties
data.description:
Changhong Jiahua Holdings Ltd. ( (HK:3991) ) just unveiled an update.

Changhong Jiahua Holdings announced on 13 November 2026 that it had entered into renewed master supply and master purchase agreements with Sichuan Changhong Holding, each covering 1 January 2027 through 31 December 2029. Over the same term, wholly owned subsidiary Changhong IT entered into a renewed financial services agreement with Changhong Finance.

The arrangements are classified as continuing connected transactions under Hong Kong listing rules. The supply agreement requires reporting, annual review, announcement, circular and independent shareholders’ approval, while the purchase agreement requires reporting, annual review and announcement but is exempt from the latter two requirements. Deposit services under the financial services agreement are subject to reporting, annual review, announcement, circular and independent shareholders’ approval requirements, with the applicable percentage ratios for maximum daily outstanding balance exceeding 5%.

data.title: Wai Chun Bio-Technology Announces FY2026 Results and Resumption of Trading
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Wai Chun Bio-Technology Ltd. ( (HK:0660) ).

Wai Chun Bio-Technology Limited announced audited consolidated results for the year ended 30 June 2026, with comparative figures for the year ended 30 June 2025; the release also addresses resumption of trading. Revenue rose to HK$404.632 million from HK$377.168 million, while gross profit increased to HK$45.298 million from HK$36.004 million.

The Group reported profit of HK$31.760 million, compared with a loss of HK$10.701 million a year earlier. Profit attributable to company owners was HK$7.205 million, while total comprehensive income reached HK$36.636 million, versus a comprehensive expense of HK$9.701 million in 2025.
